correctness.rationale: The exactly derived fair aggregate walk hits 0 or n almost surely. Conditional on every aggregate trajectory, all-positive leaf compositions have equal probability by explicit up/down predecessor mass recursions. Exact-rational absorbing-chain checks independently passed eight finite pairs; they are corroboration rather than infinite proof.

value.rationale: Simultaneous retention of all initially supported incompatible opinions is a natural social-diversity probability not fixed by one-opinion marginals. The full all-r≥3 exact law and conditional uniform terminal allocation quantitatively resolve a rare finite-population event, with general n and r and a sharp n^{-r} scaling, beyond an arbitrary small case.
